title: Adsorption of rare earth elements (REEs) onto schwertmannite and basaluminite from acid mine drainage to estuary water
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, 27,3612-3627
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00480B, Paper
Joan Gutiérrez-León, Sergio Carrero, Devis Di Tommaso, Dimitrios Toroz, Alejandro Fernandez-Martinez, Antonio Aguilar Tapia, Josep M. Soler, Jordi Cama
Rare earth elements (REEs) behavior in acid mine drainage (AMD) during neutralization in estuaries is controlled by adsorption onto schwertmannite and basaluminite surface.
